items.label: UV Protection
items.value: Our long sleeve sun shirts features cutting-edge UPF 50+ technology, effectively blocking UVA and UVB rays to ensure robust sun protection during your outdoor adventures

items.label: High-quality Materials
items.value: Crafted from lightweight, quick-drying mesh knit fabric, our long sleeve SPF shirt keeps you cool and dry even in the hottest weather, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in outdoor activities

items.label: Quick-Dry & Breathable
items.value: Designed for optimal performance, our fabric's quick-dry properties wick away moisture, while its breathable design ensures superior airflow, making it the perfect choice for staying dry during intense outdoor activities

items.label: User-friendly Design
items.value: Our UV sun shirts is equipped with a convenient sun-blocking hood, thumbholes to keep sleeves securely in place, and a tag-free collar for enhanced comfort; The raglan sleeve design offers a roomier fit in the underarm area, allowing for unrestricted arm movement; Every detail is carefully considered to ensure your comfort and convenience

items.label: Designed for Sports
items.value: This high performance men's hooded sun protection suit has great stretch so it's perfect for fishing, hiking, traveling, boating, swimming, running, exercising, or any other activity you enjoy; It is also a practical and popular holiday gift for men on Father's Day, Valentine's Day, and Fishing Day

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: hiking, rash guard, running, swimming, workout
